notes: Replication source is the final 2023 Collabra publication deposited in the assigned OSF project, with the matching title and study; author order and year differ from the supplied 2022 reference. Reported success records the authors’ overall study verdict, not an inferred verdict for this individual statistic. Original recruited sample (87 female and 81 male) is not substituted for analytic N: reported error df 154 leave test-specific inclusion unclear. Selected the explicit comparison of exposure effects between shame and guilt, rather than either separate outcome’s main effect. Original result is on PDF p. 6 (journal p. 143), one page beyond supplied locator p. 5. Original numerator df is preserved as printed. Replication partial eta squared retained although requested es_type was test statistic.
